reviewed-rer-gas-production-heat-39.name: European natural-gas production heat mix, preserved CHP and boiler shares, 3.9
reviewed-rer-gas-production-heat-39.rationale: Use complete native production-side allocated heat per signed source MJ of heat. Preserve caller quantities, formulas, supported uncertainty, separate emissions and freight. Do not reinterpret one MJ of heat as one MJ of fuel, rescale efficiencies, add combustion, duplicate emissions, add delivery networks/losses or invent co-product credits. Native fuel, performance, allocation, equipment, geography, vintage, internal uncertainty and inherited biosphere exclusions remain screening limitations; score effects are unquantified. Reconstruct the two inspected European gas-heat market groups, retaining all57 deterministic positive producer contributions per profile and their original CHP-versus-boiler shares. The three source market layers contain no direct emissions, nonheat inputs, uncertain shares or formulas. Replace the incorrect consumer-side district-network match, which adds11%heat losses. Use source-country native large-CHP heat where present and ENTSO-E otherwise. Same-capacity1MWe and500kWe native gas-engine heat uses exergy allocation; the200kWe source uses the reviewed300kWth exergy heat proxy, with electrical/thermal capacity and geography differences explicit. Boiler/furnace counterparts retain production class with native size/geography differences. No native/import loss correction is inferred.
reviewed-rer-gas-production-heat-39.reference product: heat, district or industrial, natural gas

reviews.rationale: New approval is limited to independently inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off production/market identities. Source and native references are positive one kg of sodium sulfate, with factor +1. Preserve signed caller kg, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separately listed emissions. No solution, hydration, yield, moisture or allocation multiplier is inferred. Other releases, patches, system models and reverse routes receive no approval. Both production routes are complete native screening proxies for the same named chemistry, not reconstructed exact source inventories. Native internal raw-material supply/delivery, allocation, heat and electricity, emissions, water, waste heat, age and uncertainty replace the source internal model. No extra HCl recovery/displacement credit, avoided burden, waste-treatment omission or energy balancing correction is added. Source/native LCI, LCIA and stochastic equivalence are not claimed; score effects remain unquantified. Default targets and all other existing profile entries remain unchanged. No new source omissions, runtime Python modules, alternative sector engine or validation bypass. Complete native suppliers remain available to ordinary Premise transformations. Use the two reviewed same-chemistry native producers. Native powder mix is deliberately not substituted: its observed inventory contains only 0.15 Mannheim +0.60 natural kg per reference kg and a different source portfolio. No missing 0.25 kg supply, implicit share normalization or credit is inferred. Reuse exact existing source3.9 electricity, useful industrial-gas heat and three freight correspondence scopes unchanged.
